# A small stand-in for "dircolors --print-database", so the tests do not
# depend on the installed coreutils version.
TERM xterm*
# file types
DIR 01;34
LINK 01;36
SETUID 37;41
SETGID 30;43
STICKY 37;44
# archives or compressed
.tar 01;31
.rpm 01;31
# image formats
.jpg 01;35
.xcf 01;35
# audio formats
.opus 00;36
# backup files
.tmp 00;90
# misc
.dbonly 01;33
